title: Fixed-field equivalence with its canonical stalk action
statement: Let K, Ks and Omega be fields in universe u, with compatible embeddings K -> Ks -> Omega [def-pd-separable-closure], and Omega algebraically closed. Let G=Gal(Ks/K) with the Krull topology, let H be an open subgroup of G, and set L=(Ks)^H. Assume Ks is a separable closure of K. A fixed-field comparison C consists of an equivalence E from abelian etale sheaves on Spec L [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] to discrete continuous integer H-modules [def-exc-discrete-modules-category], a natural additive isomorphism j from the underlying group of E(F) to the geometric stalk F_p at the point p:Spec Omega -> Spec L induced by L -> Ks -> Omega [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and the following action compatibility. For every F, g in H, K-automorphism tau of Omega extending g on Ks, etale L-scheme X, pointed lifts x,x' of p with x'=Spec(tau) followed by x, and section z of F on X, j_F(g*j_F^{-1}(germ_x(z)))=germ_x'(z). Such a comparison C exists. No representation R, original sheaf M, or filtration is part of the assertion.

proof.text: The open-subgroup fixed-field theorem gives L/K finite separable and fixingSubgroup(L)=H. Ks is a separable closure of L. Restriction of scalars identifies Gal(Ks/L) with H. Both Krull topologies have the same neighborhood basis of stabilizers of finite subsets of Ks, hence this group identification is a homeomorphism.

Apply the abelian geometric-stalk equivalence over L and reindex discrete representations by this homeomorphism. Retain its natural additive stalk isomorphism. An extension tau of g in H fixes L, since elements of L are fixed by g and embedded via Ks; restricting scalars turns the canonical germ formula over L into the formula specified for C. Thus the functor and its quasi-inverse are determined up to the natural isomorphisms used downstream.

    (K Ks : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Algebra K Ks]
    (H : OpenSubgroup (Gal(Ks/K))) [IsSepClosure K Ks]
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] :
    ∃ C : PrimaryFixedFieldEquivalence K Ks H,
      PrimaryFixedFieldComparison K Ks H Ω C
